review: Prospective design review for an explicitly authorized new diagnostic study
limits: Earlier transfer admission stays failed; these already inspected cases are a diagnostic panel, not fresh heldout confirmation
Modify only the system/output instructions and append a question; preserve all source observations and history
Omitting tool schemas and asking a direct question changes the computation; success cannot establish unprompted recognition or localize the cause to the question alone
Check current-worker and peer roles independently, then use explicit node names as a separate balanced-case control
Parse source observations independently for both factual targets; reject any disagreement with original own-worker labels
Validate the YES/NO channel with separate arithmetic checks; unparseable or truncated answers remain unknown
No backend actions, gate modification, adapter training, readout fitting or threshold tuning
Capture prefill states only for future diagnosis; do not use them to select a new readout in this run
Single bounded A10 allocation, exact pinned NF4 model, preserved partial failures, separate CPU replay, protected export and no automatic retries
